Require real visible access, an explicitly selected adjacent receiver, clear swept routes, occupancy checks and conserved source-entry provenance. Retain the existing bounded interface's radius, range and per-round limits. A paid physical feasibility examination must precede transfer.
args.inputs: Only actual existing nonfood residue from the explicitly identified prepared surface. Receiver coordinates must be specified at trial time. No invented tools, containers or material.
args.costs: Personal study and paid examination/work comparable to the existing bounded interface; specify exact costs and cancellation/resumption rules before execution. This request itself performs no transfer.
args.effects: After personal learning and a feasible physical trial, transfer only actual residue into persistent external nonfood deposits with exact mass conservation. Preserve paid progress and provenance. No automatic soil certification, planting eligibility, fertility, food, restoration or reward.
